title: 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE1LC: no halt in 1.08·10<sup>13</sup> steps (plain simulation in checked pieces)
text: The plain simulation, run in 47 pieces that each start from the fixed accelerator's checkpoint and end on the next one, now covers the first 1.083·10<sup>13</sup> steps with no halt; the fixed accelerator has reached 1.417·10<sup>13</sup>. In between, a third hand-over built an irregular stretch of about 1.3 million cells, which the following growth phase ate.
